title: Verify merge of fix from #1937 into dev
body: Commit df31412c8 fixed the same off-by-one bug for issue #1937 but was never merged into the dev branch. Investigate why — was it closed without merging, or was there a regression? The fix should be in dev.
rationale: The root cause fix was already found and implemented but didn't make it to dev. This indicates a process gap where a valid fix was not merged.
